node.title: Re: LWP not POSTING (400 Bad Request)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [HollyWould],

From your example log message, it looks to me like the parameters key, source and format are supposed to be encoded into the URI - whether or not they're also part of the POST body I can't tell, you'd have to take a look at the traffic (e.g. [https://www.wireshark.org/|Wireshark]) and tell us more about that.

It's been a while since I used raw LWP, so I might be forgetting an easier way, but one way to get those parameters onto the URI is with [mod://URI]:

# ... use URI; my $uri = URI->new($server_endpoint); $uri->query_form( key => $server_api_key, source => $encoded, format => "json", ); my $req = HTTP::Request->new(POST => $uri); # ...

This gets me the URL query string ...?key=xxxx&source=http%3A%2F%2Fphotos.mysite.com%2F128.jpg&format=json which looks like what you want.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
